let PercentileObservations = union (Events
| where Marker in~ ("A", "B", "C", "D")
| project EventTime_1 = todatetime(["Timestamp"]), GroupHost = ["Host"], MeasuredAmount = ["Amount"])
| where isnotnull(EventTime_1) and isnotempty(GroupHost);
let PercentileWindowValues = materialize(
PercentileObservations
| project GroupHost, PercentileWindowEnd = EventTime_1, PercentileTimeBin = bin(EventTime_1, 5m)
| distinct *
| join kind=inner (
PercentileObservations
| where isnotnull(MeasuredAmount) and isfinite(MeasuredAmount)
| extend PercentileTimeBin = pack_array(bin(EventTime_1, 5m), bin(EventTime_1, 5m) + 5m)
| mv-expand PercentileTimeBin to typeof(datetime)
) on GroupHost, PercentileTimeBin
| where EventTime_1 between ((PercentileWindowEnd - 5m) .. PercentileWindowEnd)
| project GroupHost, PercentileWindowEnd, MeasuredAmount
);
PercentileWindowValues
| join kind=inner (
PercentileWindowValues | summarize PercentilePopulation = count() by GroupHost, PercentileWindowEnd
) on GroupHost, PercentileWindowEnd
| project GroupHost, PercentileWindowEnd, MeasuredAmount, PercentilePopulation
| sort by GroupHost asc, PercentileWindowEnd asc, MeasuredAmount asc
| serialize PercentileRank = row_number(1, GroupHost != prev(GroupHost) or PercentileWindowEnd != prev(PercentileWindowEnd))
| where PercentileRank == max_of(1, (PercentilePopulation / 100) * 50 + tolong(ceiling(toreal((PercentilePopulation % 100) * 50) / 100.0)))
| extend ValuePercentile = MeasuredAmount
| where ValuePercentile >= 10000
| project WindowStart = PercentileWindowEnd - 5m, WindowEnd = PercentileWindowEnd, ["Host"] = GroupHost, ValuePercentile
